description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for internal configuration management within the Fineract platform. It allows updating configuration properties via HTTP PUT requests and contains logging, dependency injection, and lifecycle management components. The class is annotated for Spring and JAX-RS integration and is active only in the TEST profile.

classes.name: InternalConfigurationsApiResource
classes.description: A REST resource class that handles internal configuration updates for the Fineract platform, configured for testing environments.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the bean and logs warnings to prevent use in production.

methods.name: updateGlobalConfiguration
methods.description: Updates a global configuration property identified by name, potentially updates rounding mode via MoneyHelperInitializationService, and returns HTTP OK status.
